entry.author: 1News
entry.summary:
This week’s ASB Good as Gold recipient is Linda Howard of Invercargill, a tireless community fundraiser whose creativity and generosity have strengthened Southland for decades. 

For more than 10 years, Linda has brought the community together by producing imaginative, large‑scale events in support of Hospice Southland, including this year’s 'Stars in Their Eyes' concert. A hairdresser for over 50 years, Linda also gives time behind the scenes, volunteering her skills and rallying local businesses, friends, and clients to donate goods, services, and support. 

Beyond headline events, Linda consistently steps up for charity initiatives, offering expertise, energy, and practical help wherever it is needed. Over the years, these efforts have helped raise more than $60,000 for Hospice Southland. ASB is proud to recognise Linda Howard with $10,000 as this week’s ASB Good as Gold recipient.
